title: XREPLAY-2 decision probe: same qwen3.8-27b -> gpt-5.6-sol switch as RT-XREPLAY1, but the sol row now carries lenient_reasoning_content_strip=true (strict_responses_input=false on both rows, unchanged). XREPLAY-1 proved the verbatim ride (content+id) is REJECTED by Azure with 400 array_above_max_length on input[N].content; this probe runs the surgical cut: content stripped at send time, id + summary ride verbatim. Outcomes: 200 + content-stripped + id-riding = CUT AS DESIGNED; 400 on the id field = FLAG COLLAPSE (coordinator rules); any other 400 = unexpected. RED-FIRST: against the pre-cut binary this case must RED (unknown config key rejected at load, or the same Azure 400 as XREPLAY-1).

wire.label: CONTROL (anti-vacuous pin, unchanged from XREPLAY-1): at least one pre-switch qwen request carried a reasoning INPUT item — real qwen reasoning was emitted, stored, and replayed. If no qwen request ever carried one, this FAILs and the probe is meaningless.
CUT VERIFIED (1/3): the post-switch sol request still carries the reasoning INPUT item — the lenient projection strips content but must not drop the item itself.

CUT VERIFIED (2/3): NO sol request carries a reasoning content part — the lenient strip fired on every post-switch request (the exact field Azure rejected with array_above_max_length in XREPLAY-1). Fail-closed: an empty filtered set is a harness failure.

CUT VERIFIED (3/3): the reasoning item STILL carries its prior-response id (rs_* — codex Layer B shape: content stripped, id + summary ride verbatim). If the upstream rejects THIS field, the case 400s on the id and the verdict is FLAG COLLAPSE — the resp_status assert records the param.
NO RETRY STORM (unchanged): exactly one post-switch sol request — the probe fired once; 0 = never fired, >=2 = retry storm. Also makes the three CUT VERIFIED greps same-file pins.

ACCEPTANCE (ASSERTIVE this time — the fix must be accepted): the post-switch sol request must be accepted with HTTP 200. 400 = the cut did not clear the upstream (FLAG COLLAPSE if the param is the id field; UNEXPECTED otherwise — the exact error JSON is recorded in the detail). Pre-cut binary: this assert is the RED (same Azure 400 as XREPLAY-1, or an earlier config-load failure).

XREPLAY-2 VERDICT RECORD: last-captured wire response status line, verbatim (machine-readable finding; recon op — always records, never fails). The authoritative verdict is the resp_status assert above (n-paired to the sol request); this line is the raw resp-capture record.
